svg.title: How Smarter initializes its settings
svg.desc: Deployment sources (GitHub Actions secrets, the Kubernetes Secrets that smarter-infrastructure creates, and the Helm chart's values) and local sources (.env and user-settings/settings.yaml) become the process's environment variables, through the deploy action and the Helm release's env Secret, or Docker Compose. smarter_settings reads them into its fields, whose defaults it declares, with the code constants of smarter.common.const, and validates them. Django's settings modules derive their settings from smarter_settings, then the user's own settings file and DJANGO_* variables supersede them. The startup logs, the initialize commands, and the web console read the result.
svg.text: from the sources a deployment or a developer controls, to the values that Django runs with
make adds a new Fernet key
your own Django settings, in YAML
merges them with the GitHub secrets
every pod reads it with envFrom:
api, workers, beat, init and migrate
or an empty value is the default
③ local · alpha · beta · next · prod
locally, user-settings/ is mounted into each container, where apply_user_settings reads it (④)
smarter_settings: the literal default → SMARTER_NAME → NAME
Django: ① base.py → ② base_aws.py → ③ the environment's module → ④ the user settings file → ⑤ DJANGO_* variables
